assertions.title: Unresolved image primitives never remain on the batch presenter
assertions.reason: The focused host suite passed, and the relevant test showed unresolved image resources trigger batch rejection and a same-session downgrade to the frame presenter.

evidence.mapping: The terminal snapshot shows WinSwiftUI logging batch failure and switching to the frame renderer because image primitives had no valid bound resources for texture ID -1. The cited test then asserts frameRenderer.attachedSurfaces.count == 1 and frameRenderer.renderedFrames.count == 1 after the failure, proving same-session host downgrade and frame presentation.

commandsRun.observation: Passed. WinSwiftUIWindowHostTests executed 32 tests with 0 failures; the relevant case logged unresolved image resource rejection and frame-presenter downgrade in the same suite run.

summary: Validated VAL-RENDER-007 via the required WinSwiftUIWindowHostTests suite. The suite passed, and host-level evidence confirmed unresolved image primitives trigger batch rejection and same-session downgrade to frame presentation.
